Blueberries due to E. coli.

I guess one way to bring down Americans’ grocery bills is to leave us with nothing safe to buy.

Starbucks’ CEO made 6,666x more than the company's median employee in 2024.

In 2025, he made 1,794x more.

And we're supposed to believe Starbucks can't afford to bargain a fair contract with its unionized workers?

I will continue my boycott of Starbucks. Solidarity with @sbworkersunited.org

See a pattern?

I remember when polio put my friends into iron lungs.

We lined up at school to get vaccinated. We eradicated the disease. We protected the common good and saved lives.

Now, two unvaccinated people have died from measles.

What RFK Jr. is doing to public health in America is a disgrace.
